diseasesList.bacterialLeafBlightDesc: A bacterial disease that causes wilting, yellowing, and leaf drying.
diseasesList.bacterialLeafBlightTreatment: Remove infected plants, avoid excess nitrogen, and use recommended bactericide guidance from local agronomy services.
diseasesList.bacterialLeafBlightPrevention: Use resistant varieties, keep field drainage good, and avoid unnecessary leaf damage during field work.
diseasesList.brownSpotDesc: A fungal disease that creates brown lesions on leaves and can reduce grain quality.
diseasesList.brownSpotTreatment: Apply recommended fungicide practices and correct nutrient imbalance, especially potassium and silicon where needed.
diseasesList.brownSpotPrevention: Maintain balanced fertilization, avoid water stress, and monitor fields regularly during humid periods.
diseasesList.healthyDesc: The uploaded leaf does not show a strong sign of disease from the model output.
diseasesList.healthyTreatment: No treatment is needed. Keep monitoring the crop and maintain normal agronomic practices.
diseasesList.healthyPrevention: Continue routine scouting, proper irrigation, and balanced fertilization to preserve crop health.
diseasesList.leafBlastDesc: A common fungal rice disease that creates diamond-shaped lesions and rapid leaf damage.
diseasesList.leafBlastTreatment: Use a recommended fungicide program and remove heavily infected debris when possible.
diseasesList.leafBlastPrevention: Choose resistant varieties, avoid excess nitrogen, and maintain proper spacing for airflow.
diseasesList.leafScaldDesc: A fungal disease that appears as elongated lesions with pale centers and darker edges.
diseasesList.leafScaldTreatment: Apply an approved fungicide if recommended and reduce plant stress with balanced crop care.
diseasesList.leafScaldPrevention: Improve field sanitation, avoid over-fertilization, and inspect crops after wet weather.
diseasesList.narrowBrownSpotDesc: A fungal disease that produces narrow brown lines on leaves and can reduce photosynthesis.
diseasesList.narrowBrownSpotTreatment: Use fungicide guidance from local extension services and correct nutrient deficiencies.
diseasesList.narrowBrownSpotPrevention: Maintain healthy spacing, balanced fertilization, and regular disease scouting.
